query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Aggregate and act on personal productivity signals across email, calendar, GitHub, LinkedIn, and SMS; additionally configure SMS receiving/sending and manage calendar access/events.
query_ground_truth.query: purchase a ClickSend phone number and set up incoming SMS automations
query_ground_truth.rationale: Configuring SMS receiving involves searching/buying a number and setting up the inbound automation endpoints.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: ClickSend is a cloud-based SMS and email marketing platform that enables businesses to send and receive SMS messages, manage contacts, and track campaign performance.
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=clicksend. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="clicksend") to create a connection BEFORE executing any clicksend tools.

CLICKSEND_POST_NUMBERS_BUY.description: Tool to purchase a dedicated phone number from ClickSend. Use when you need to buy a specific number for SMS messaging and other communication services.

type.description: The type of service for the number (e.g., 'sms')

dedicated_number.description: The phone number to purchase, including country code (e.g., '+14155551234')

CLICKSEND_CREATE_AUTOMATIONS_SMS_INBOUND.description: Tool to create a new inbound SMS automation rule in ClickSend. Use when you need to set up automated actions to trigger when inbound SMS messages are received.

action.description: Action to perform when rule matches. Valid values: AUTO_REPLY, EMAIL_USER, EMAIL_FIXED, URL, SMS, POLL, GROUP_SMS, MOVE_CONTACT, CREATE_CONTACT, CREATE_CONTACT_PLUS_EMAIL, CREATE_CONTACT_PLUS_NAME_EMAIL, CREATE_CONTACT_PLUS_NAME, SMPP, NONE.

enabled.description: Controls activation status of the rule. 0 = disabled, 1 = enabled.

rule_name.description: Name of the automation rule to identify it. Helps organize and manage multiple rules.

webhook_type.description: Webhook format type. Valid values: 'post', 'get', or 'json'. Defaults to 'post' if not specified.

action_address.description: Target destination for the specified action. For EMAIL_FIXED provide email address, for URL provide webhook URL, for contact lists provide list ID.

dedicated_number.description: The dedicated phone number to apply this rule to. Use '*' to apply the rule to all numbers.

message_search_term.description: Text pattern to match against incoming messages. Can be null for message_search_type=0 (any message).

message_search_type.description: Message matching logic. 0 = Any message, 1 = starts with, 2 = contains, 3 = does not contain.

CLICKSEND_GET_NUMBERS_SEARCH.description: Tool to search for available dedicated numbers by country code. Use when you need to find purchasable phone numbers for messaging services in a specific country.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Must be at least 1.

limit.description: Number of records per page. Must be at least 1.

search.description: Search pattern or query to match against available phone numbers

country.description: Two-letter country code to search for available dedicated numbers (e.g., 'US', 'AU', 'GB')

search_type.description: Search strategy: 0 = starts with, 1 = anywhere, 2 = ends with
